regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Doris Panyard. Many thank for your king favor of May 4th, duly Rec'd and noted. We'll pray for that. Rev. Father and will hope something bigger and better may follow the $1000.00 turkey dinner. Glad to hear of Grace's favorable surprise. Thanks be to God for every blessing.

regions.merged_text: It just struck 11 now: so I'll say for the present .... Good Night and again God bless you and yours. Sincerely in Christ
